delta.caption: Stored paired isotropic delta (fourbar − gearbox); only regular finite eligible pairs are shown. Unavailable pairs remain blank and their exclusion reasons are available in the cell inspector.

identity_scalar.caption: Identity-on-shared-Q reference uses its own full finite range [0.500376, 0.614637], with no clipped values. Compare numeric values using the inspector; this scale differs from the primary paired scale.

polygons.caption: Shape-normalized polygon glyphs only. Glyph size is not force magnitude.

positive_x.caption: Directional ray capacity (positive_x). Undefined/unbounded cells are masked; Cartesian and radial/tangential statuses are independent.

positive_y.caption: Directional ray capacity (positive_y). Undefined/unbounded cells are masked; Cartesian and radial/tangential statuses are independent.

radial.caption: Directional ray capacity (radial). Undefined/unbounded cells are masked; Cartesian and radial/tangential statuses are independent.

ratio.caption: Stored paired isotropic ratio (fourbar / gearbox); only regular finite eligible pairs are shown. Unavailable pairs remain blank and their exclusion reasons are available in the cell inspector.

scalar.caption: Primary view: isotropic radius on the retained mounted-Q grid (axes show grid indices; cell JSON stores exact Q). Paired colour limits [0.685805, 3.90713]. Force units: normalized_torque_per_length.

status.caption: Categorical stored whole-set status for all three arms. A set can be unbounded while some directional capacities remain finite; inspect their separate field statuses below. Blank cells were not sampled.

tangential.caption: Directional ray capacity (tangential). Undefined/unbounded cells are masked; Cartesian and radial/tangential statuses are independent.

true_scale_detail.caption: True-scale force polygons with common force axes. Selected q_sample_id=span_j1_135_j2_145__q_0016_0015.

inherited_tolerances.note: Rank, direction, and near-singular thresholds are inherited from the V3.6E API; V4.3 does not retune them for display.
